# Browser stack-trace fixtures

Extracted unchanged from `stacktracejs/error-stack-parser` test fixtures (MIT).

Source: https://github.com/stacktracejs/error-stack-parser/blob/master/spec/fixtures/captured-errors.js

- `chrome-v8.log`: Chromium/V8, also representative of modern Opera.
- `firefox-spidermonkey.log`: Firefox/SpiderMonkey.
- `safari-webkit.log`: Safari/WebKit.
- `opera-blink.log`: historical Opera Blink/V8 control fixture.
